crossRefs.note: As for the ten horns, ten kings will arise out of this kingdom. Another will arise after them; and he will be different…
Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his…

translations.web: As the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom will be partly strong, and partly broken.
translations.bsb: And as the toes of the feet were partly iron and partly clay, so this kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.
translations.kjv: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.
translations.asv: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.
